This '''B1 battle droid''' was stationed on the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lola Sayu/Legends|Lola Sayu]] in the [[Citadel/Legends|Citadel]] [[Prison/Legends|prison]] around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]].

==Biography==
During the [[Battle of Lola Sayu/Legends|Battle of Lola Sayu]], this [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-series battle droid]] along with many others were under command of prison [[Warden/Legends|warden]], [[Phindian/Legends|Phindian]] [[Osi Sobeck/Legends|Osi Sobeck]]. When a squad of [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-series battle droid]]s, [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2s]] [[R2-D2's battle droid squadron/Legends|droid squadron]], arrived on the Citadel's landing bay with a group of prisoners, including [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Even Piell/Legends|Even Piell]], this droid asked the [[OOM-10/Legends|leader]] of the squad where they were taking the prisoners. The [[OOM-series battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] replied that the prisoners were to be taken to [[Point Tarron/Legends|Point Tarron]], which made this droid suspicious as there were no outposts on Tarron. In the end, after the OOM-class droid insisted that they have orders, this droid let them go. After a few seconds however, this droid was informed by [[K2-B4/Legends|K2-B4]] that the prisoners were actually lead by reprogrammed battle droids and that they were escaping. Before having time to react, this droid was cut in half by Obi-Wan's [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]].

==Behind the scenes==
This B1 battle droid, like every battle droid in [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (film)|''The Clone Wars'' movie]] and [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars|''The Clone Wars'' TV series]], was voiced by [[Matthew Wood]]. His name was never given.
